Store: Shopify Plus (headless storefront). Catalog ~4k SKUs, many long descriptions (300-1200 chars). Primary ask: product Q&A assistant on PDPs (short answers, cite attributes). Secondary: automated attribute extraction to fill missing size/material tags and feed search relevance models. Traffic pattern: steady daily traffic with occasional flash bursts (email drops + IG promos) — concern about token spikes during promotions.

POC success criteria (customer): 1) median Q&A latency <200ms for average queries; 2) 80% cost reduction vs naive per-request generation using caching/batching; 3) simple JS embed that supports streaming answers.

Quotes from call: "We want something that feels instant on the product page — if it's slow customers drop off." — Head of Product.

Technical constraints: prefer hosted API (no on-prem), need US data residency, basic SSO for admin console (SSO/SAML), and audit logs for content changes. PIM: Shopify native + a small custom product import flow. Interested in Redwood's Optimize suggestions for batching/quantization.

Commercial notes: price sensitive — SMB budget, likely 1-2k ARR first year if POC successful. Open to upgrade to Dedicated only if predictable burst SLA and commit pricing make sense.

Internal follow-ups: SE to run short load test simulating 5x burst for 10 minutes and report expected token burn and latency with caching enabled. AE to prepare a low-friction billing/commit proposal if POC metrics look good.
